# Profile is active (`profile_active`)

**Kind:** condition · **Category:** Context · **Available in:** personal and machine automations

True when the profile is currently applied (or, with active: false, when it is not).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profile` | text | yes |  | Profile id. |
| `active` | true / false | no | `true` | Set to false to require that the profile is not applied. |

## Example

```yaml
conditions:
  - type: profile_active
    profile: gaming
    active: false
```
